claim: re-download by version is sha-stable (EXT-001 C6 a)
finding: the pull cache hit compares file size only yet prints "cached, verified"; a re-download rewrites .apr-manifest.json with the new hashes, so a same-size re-pushed revision is accepted silently. `apr model gate` M0 catches it on a release dir; pull alone does not
proposed: on a cache hit, verify sha256 against the manifest; refuse a manifest rewrite whose hash differs unless --refresh

claim: apr serves C2 TTFT comparable with the reference on the blessed model (EXT-001 C2)
finding: CPU TTFT for a 681-byte prompt is 69–93 s (medians of 5, lambda-cpu, 16 threads) against llama.cpp 0.5–0.7 s on the same file and CPUs: prefill appears to run token by token through the decode path rather than as a batched forward
proposed: batch the CPU prefill (one forward over the prompt) and gate TTFT in the C2 ledger

claim: apr CPU decode is competitive with llama.cpp on Q4_K_M (EXT-001 C2)
finding: decode medians 0.85–1.82 tok/s against llama.cpp 3.94–4.30 tok/s on the same file, CPUs and threads; ITL 410–738 ms against 205–217 ms
proposed: profile with apr profile on a quiet host; the C2 ledger ratchet records the gap per release

claim: apr serves a 2.75 GB Q4_K_M file in comparable memory
finding: peak RSS 7.9 GiB against llama.cpp 4.4 GiB on the same file (mistral.rs 8.1 GiB)
where: model load / weight residency in aprender-serve
proposed: account for the extra ~3.5 GiB (dequantized copies or duplicated buffers) with apr profile

claim: the ratchet (median-3 floor, 5% tolerance) catches a planted regression and passes an unpatched control
finding: on the shared lambda host (load 30–55) the planted 1 s/step sleep is RED but the unpatched control is RED too, both sequential and with resident interleaved arms; per-iteration apr decode spans 0.53–2.22 tok/s on one binary while llama.cpp spans 2.8–4.7, so contention does not cancel in the ratio
proposed: cop decision: quiet-host rule for ledger records, or a contention-robust statistic fixed in advance (e.g. best-of-N); not a tolerance edit after the data
